thread:
olivia: Bringing up pyxis-v1 embeddings in staging — quick sanity checks. Can someone run recall@k + cluster sanity?

maria: I can run recall@1/5/10 on the wiki holdout. Any baseline to compare?

jun: baseline = beryl-v2 (float16). Quick results after first pass: recall@1: 0.62 -> pyxis 0.59, recall@5: 0.82 -> 0.81, recall@10 roughly same.

olivia: hmm 3% hit at R@1 is annoying. Was that int8 quant or float16?

jun: float16 for that run. I also did int8 symmetric quant this morning: recall@1 dropped to 0.54.

sasha: can you paste the eval snippet you used? also run silhouette and kmeans n_clusters=100 to see cluster collapse.

jun: eval command: ```python eval_embeddings.py --model pyxis-v1 --dataset wiki-holdout --metrics recall@1,5,10,silhouette --kmeans 100``` output sample: ```R@1:0.59,R@5:0.81,R@10:0.87,silhouette:0.12```

maria: silhouette 0.12 is low vs baseline 0.18. Maybe embedding norm shift or spectral collapse after layernorm tweak. Any PCA/UMAP plots?

olivia: pushed a quick UMAP to the staging bucket: gs://redwood-staging/pyxis-v1/umap.png (link). Looks like small tight clusters with some overlap.

raj: two hypotheses: tokenization differences (we changed unk handling) or last-layer pooling change. Can we run a tiny A/B: same inputs through beryl-v2 and pyxis-v1 with identical pooling to isolate?

sasha: also try per-channel quantization (int8-perchannel) — that helped other models. Raj, can you run quant-perch?

raj: on it. launching int8-perchannel job now. deploy-bot: Deploy request: model=pyxis-v1 quant=int8-perchannel env=staging -> started (job 3421).

jun: quick intermediate from per-channel run: recall@1=0.57, silhouette=0.14. Better than symmetric int8 but still worse than float16 baseline.

maria: good sign. Can we compute mean vector norms for 10k sample across models? If pyxis norms are shrunk that explains low R@1.

olivia: running norm check: ```python -c "import numpy as np; print(np.mean(np.linalg.norm(X,axis=1)))"``` results: beryl-v2 mean_norm=12.2, pyxis-fp16=9.8, pyxis-int8=9.1

sasha: definite norm shrink. Options: re-scale embeddings post-hoc, or adjust training/normalization. For immediate fix, we can L2-scale to baseline mean before indexing. Try re-scaling and re-eval R@1.

jun: re-scaled (multiplier=12.2/9.8) -> recall@1 = 0.60 on float16, int8-perchannel scaled -> 0.56. Narrowed gap but still ~0.02 short of baseline.

olivia: action items: 1) Raj to try tokenization-aligned run (same pooling/tokenizer) 2) Sasha to bake per-channel int8 with calibrations and try per-row bias fix 3) Jun/Maria to run full kmeans 1000 and silhouette suite + visualizations. I'll open a ticket for model training team to check layernorm/config.

maria: i posted eval scripts + dataset manifest here: <link-to-eval-scripts>  feel free to reuse.

raj: tokenization-aligned run queued. ETA ~15m.

deploy-bot: Job 3421 finished: status=success, artifacts=gs://redwood-staging/pyxis-v1/int8-perchannel/metrics.json

sasha: grabbing metrics.json now. Quick sanity: precision@1 and MRR also slightly behind. Need to check hard negatives in holdout set.

jun: thanks everyone. If per-channel + scaling + tokenizer alignment still worse, we should probably hold pyxis for now and ask training to produce a version with matched embedding norms or add norm head.

olivia: agree. Keeping thread open for final numbers. :thumbsup:
